> Pool tables, darts, shuffle board, cocktails and an extensive beer list on Brand Blvd in downtown Glendale. Rated 4.3 from 393 Google reviews.

## About
Mr. Furley's is a local bar where you can enjoy tasty cocktails, an extensive beer list, fresh hand crafted food and a variety of games. Prices are inexpensive and ordering is tavern style, so you set the pace.
The room is big. Reviewers mention red pool tables, shuffle board, darts, a photo booth and a full bar with a wooden counter top. It's a good spot for a drink after work, a birthday with friends or a casual night out.
We sit right on Brand Blvd in downtown Glendale, with sister bars in Sherman Oaks and North Hollywood. Rated 4.3 from 393 Google reviews.

## Services
- Tasty cocktails: Cocktails with unique nicknames, poured by friendly bartenders.
- Extensive beer list: Craft beers and a long list on tap to work through.
- Fresh hand crafted food: Bar food and appetizers for when the cravings hit. One reviewer's favorites are the cheese logs and beef skewers.
- A variety of games: Pool tables, darts, shuffle board and a photo booth.
- Book a party: Birthdays, get togethers and organized events. Ask about our private areas.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open every day, 5:00 PM to 2:00 AM.

Q: How do I book a party?
A: Use the book a party form. That's also the place to ask questions about a party.

Q: I left my card or something at the bar. How do I get it back?
A: Just come in any day after 5pm to pick it up.

Q: Where do I park?
A: One reviewer notes metered street parking, a parking structure one block over and a lot behind the building. All of it is paid, but it won't break the bank.

## What customers say
- "We’ve been to this location many times and on a variety of days, primarily Thursday, Friday and Saturday, all at night between 8pm and 1am. This place is pretty great, it’s a very large venue, they have more pool tables than a pool hall, if you want to have a private party they have 2 private areas you can rent for a very reasonable price, they have many beers on tap and a good selection of appetizers you can also order if you’re getting any cravings.

The private room on the main floor is all the way in the back, beyond the pool tables available to the general population. It is clearly separated so no one will accidentally wonder into the area. In this room you’ll have your own pool tables, shuffle board and dart board. You also get your own bathroom and bar with a bar tender which has access to the same things that the main bar has outside of the private room.

In general I’d say this is a great venue to have get togethers, wether it’s a casual night out with friends, an organized event or just going out with a bunch of friends for a birthday and meeting up here. The place is very large so you wouldn’t really have to give them advanced notice even if you’re having like 40-50 people meeting up there. Welllll… maybe if it’s like a random Tuesday night or something… but I wouldn’t really know about that.

Their food is also so good, my favorites include the cheese logs and beef skewers but I haven’t ever ordered anything I didn’t like.

The venue is facing brand blvd so it’s usually happening on these nights, you’ll see people coming and going to the variety of locations around the venue.

The parking is not ideal. You have street parking where you’ll have to pay at the meter but it’s usually a challenge to find a spot. There is a parking structure one block over. And there is a parking lot right behind the venue, where you’d typically find an alley, this is the least ideal parking since there is no direct path to the other side of the block so you’re walking all the way around. All parking costs money, but not going to break the bank.

The service has been consistent with a typical bar, during the rush you may be waiting a few minutes but you won’t get ignored.

The ambiance has always been fun, there is positive energy in the air, people are there to have a good time, good drinks and good food.

Overall, we’ve been coming to this spot for a while and definitely see ourselves coming in the future." (Sarkis Mazmanian, 5/5)
- "I love Mr. Furley’s and a big part of that is because of the bartender, Will, who I’ve been served by a couple of times. You can tell he pays attention to the details that keep the bat running smoothly. He always seems aware of what’s needed, has communicated with us the next best option when something was out of stock, and has brought a lot of care and intention to connecting to our group. He is so professional yet friendly and warm that we felt special. He brought a kind of attentiveness and thoughtfulness that makes Mr. Furley’s feel like a warm and welcoming place to spend our nights out." (Mattie Wiseman, 5/5)
- "Mr Furley’s Bar is one of the popular dive bar in downtown Glendale. This bar is extremely spacious with multiple red pool  tables, tv and a full bar with wooden counter top. Similarly, they have photo booth and clean restroom.

Their alcoholic drinks from beers to cocktails are extensive with unique nicknames as well bar food. Bartender is friendly and competent. We came here to grab a drink after work and watch the NBA and Dodgers games. Plenty of parking garage in the area.

Overall, I had a good time at Mr. Furley. I highly recommend." (Carlo N., 5/5)
- "Pool! Photo Booth! Darts! Shuffle board! So many activities!! Great cocktails, Emma is the best bartender. We had so much fun!

Went on Wednesday at 6pm, wasn’t crowded. Vibes were excellent." (Jessica Wilcox, 5/5)
- "We only went to play but it was great for that.. there's lots of tables and there was a shuffle board which was the first time I got to use one and I loved it... They were playing all the games.. they have a wide variety of drinks and even some food.. I didn't try any of that & I didn't pay so idk how it was on the end but we had fun, the bartender was polite to us and quick... It was cool for what it is 😏" (Melissa Rizo, 4/5)
